Name: MountainFarm by StoutGoi
Author: StoutGoi
Description:
A farm on a mountainside.

The farm includes many respawning stumps and logs, forest forage, and blue grass. 

You start with an empty barn. There's also a quick shortcut to the beach!

Intended for a heavily modded playthrough with lots of additional crops and trees.

It is intentional that some forage will end up on the unreachable part of the mountain. Otherwise, I always appreciate a detailed bug report (although I am busy so no promises on patches).
